name: RBLN SDK (Rebellions compiler, runtime, vLLM)
notes: RBLN Compiler, Runtime, Profiler. vLLM-rbln, Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve. Optimum RBLN for HuggingFace. Bucketing tutorial. Dynamic batch sizes. Automatic prefix caching. Kubernetes support. Rebel100: 1024 FP16 / 2048 FP8 TFLOPS, 144 GB HBM3E, 4.8 TB/s.
